AP News

A look at how Ethiopia's wars, sea ambitions and Nile dam fuel fears of wider conflict

An AP explainer published October 19 links Ethiopia's renewed Tigray war, its drive for sea access and the Nile dam to fears of a wider regional conflict; the 2020-2022 war killed an estimated 500,000 people. The International Crisis Group's Magnus Taylor said the new rebel alliance “combines political opposition to Abiy with military strength.”

Can diplomacy stop another Ethiopia-Eritrea war?

DW asked on October 19 whether diplomacy can avert a new Ethiopia-Eritrea war after Abiy Ahmed installed a caretaker administration in Tigray on October 16, with elections promised in six months. The two countries severed diplomatic ties on October 1; the African Union has urged both, and Egypt, to show restraint.
